checks: Two points: circle origin, red destination pin; request contains both selected coordinates
Granted browser Geolocation recenters to supplied device fix, renders blue dot and preserves route/manual origin
Append destination focuses new row and promotes old destination to waypoint; markers contain no letter badges
Reorder preserves row ID and values while updating roles, markers and request order
Deleting a waypoint preserves origin/destination and recalculates without resetting the list
390px/360px responsive: no horizontal overflow, GPS target at least 44px outside sheet, portal options clickable
Use GPS as origin: request uses exact device latitude/longitude without changing other places
Card action inserts the selected waypoint immediately before the existing destination
Keyboard reordering via Alt+ArrowUp updates the same stable rows and route order
Six-point limit is visible and prevents adding a seventh row without silently dropping any selected point
GPS denied: clear error, no fabricated user marker
GPS timeout: clear error, no fabricated user marker
GPS unavailable: clear error, no fabricated user marker
GPS prompt: explicit action calls platform API; supplied fix rendered (permission dialog itself not verified)
